posts.title: Roundup: October 2026 deliveries by major Chinese automakers
posts.summary:
Xpeng's monthly deliveries topped 50,000 for the first time, while Nio and Li Auto both saw declines.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: October delivery data reveals a significant divergence in the Chinese EV market, with Xpeng hitting a record 50,000+ units while established players like Nio and Li Auto face volume declines.
Leapmotor maintained strong momentum with over 100,000 deliveries for the fourth consecutive month, while Xiaomi Auto also surpassed the 50,000-unit milestone.
The Huawei-led HIMA alliance experienced a sharp downturn, with deliveries falling over 50% year-on-year, pushing its year-to-date growth into negative territory.
BYD continues to dominate the sector, reporting 490,168 sales in October, supported by a record-breaking performance in its battery electric vehicle segment.

posts.title: BYD sales rise 11% to year-to-date high in October as BEVs top 300,000 for first time
posts.summary:
BYD sold 490,168 NEVs in October, marking its sixth consecutive month of year-on-year growth.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD achieved a year-to-date high in October with 490,168 NEV sales, driven by a record 305,743 battery electric vehicle (BEV) deliveries.
The company's sales mix is shifting heavily toward pure electric models, which now account for 63.28% of passenger vehicle sales, up from 50.95% a year ago.
Plug-in hybrid sales experienced a 17.23% year-on-year decline, marking the second consecutive month of contraction for that segment.
Despite a slight easing in year-on-year growth rates, BYD's export volume remains robust at 170,194 units, up 102.84% compared to the previous year.

posts.title: Huawei HIMA October deliveries halve, pushing year-to-date total into decline
posts.summary:
HIMA delivered 33,537 vehicles in October, down 50.84% year-on-year, marking its fifth consecutive month of year-on-year declines.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: The Huawei-led HIMA alliance saw October deliveries drop 50.84% year-on-year to 33,537 units, the lowest level since April.
Cumulative year-to-date deliveries have turned negative for the first time this year, falling 3.91% compared to the same period in 2025.
The alliance is undergoing structural changes, including a new cooperation model with Seres for the Aito brand to streamline product definition and marketing operations.

posts.title: Nio October deliveries fall 15.23%, ending 31-month streak of year-on-year growth
posts.summary:
October deliveries of  34,246 vehicles were the lowest since April, as Onvo's decline offset year-on-year growth at the Nio main brand and Firefly.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio Inc reported 34,246 deliveries in October, marking its first year-on-year decline in over 30 months.
The Onvo brand continues to struggle, posting a 51.66% year-on-year decline, which offset the growth seen in the Nio main brand and the Firefly sub-brand.
Firefly remains a bright spot for the company, setting a monthly delivery record for the second consecutive month and accounting for 22.6% of total company volume.

posts.title: Xpeng monthly deliveries top 50,000 for first time in October
posts.summary:
Xpeng delivered 50,237 vehicles in October, with overseas deliveries reaching a record high and domestic deliveries hitting a 1-year high.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Xpeng surpassed the 50,000-unit delivery milestone for the first time in October, signaling a major inflection point for the company's growth.
The record performance was supported by strong domestic demand, which hit a one-year high, alongside record-breaking overseas delivery figures.
This surge in volume suggests that Xpeng's recent product strategy and market expansion efforts are successfully capturing increased consumer interest.
